summary: Iteration 36: Chat product card from product page + Accurate Tahap 2 (A pull sync preview/apply, B sales invoice push) tested against local mock Accurate host (127.0.0.1:9911). Backend 13/13 pytest pass (chat card once/new-on-switch, sync preview counts price1/stock2/new1, apply with skip, re-apply 400, price_history source accurate, new product inactive & hidden publicly, conflict detection, invoice settings, orders sent/unsent lists, preview lines incl. ONGKIR & warehouse, confirm false 400, confirm true 200 sent, second send 409, SKU/unmapped-branch problems 400, COD-not-completed ineligible, Accurate rejection -> failed & retryable, non-admin 403). Frontend (375x667): chat card shows full product name, tapping card opens product, no duplicate card on re-tap, different product adds a new card; /admin/accurate sections 4 & 5 render, preview -> untick row (count 4->3) -> confirm dialog -> success text 'Tersimpan: 1 harga, 1 stok, 1 barang baru'; invoice settings save, order preview, send via confirm -> 'Sudah di Accurate', moved to 'Sudah dikirim' tab. One minor UI bug: success message after sending invoice is wiped immediately.

minor.issue: If Accurate times out after actually saving the invoice, state becomes 'failed'; a retry then gets 'Nomor faktur sudah dipakai' (502) forever and the order can never be marked sent. Consider treating 'number already used' as sent / offering a manual 'mark as sent' reconcile.
Invoice ignores order 'refunded' amount (e.g. PGS-261108-9749B2 refunded 5000) - invoice total = order total, refund not reflected. Confirm business expectation.

Duplicate guard only compares with the very LAST message; if buyer/store sent any text after the card, reopening chat from the same product posts the same product card again. Acceptable per comment, but consider checking the last product card instead of the last message.

ui_bugs.issue: Success message 'Faktur X masuk ke Accurate' never visible: send() calls load() in its finally, and load -> run('list') calls setMsg(null) synchronously, wiping the ok message (verified: accurate-invoice-msg-ok absent after send). Also run('list')'s busy gets reset by the outer run's finally. Fix: reload list without clearing msg (e.g. separate loader that doesn't setMsg(null), or await load before setMsg). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/accurate-invoices.tsx:29-51

rca_of_issue: Invoice success msg: run() helper always does setMsg(null) at start; send() invokes load() (which uses run) inside its own try/finally after setMsg(ok), so the ok message is cleared in the same tick.
